title: Problem Radar
scope: Internal manual pilot: IT, digital workflows and software problems in small teams and organisations. DE/EN, preferably DACH/EU. No automated retrieval.
sourceHint: New sources start pending and paused. Every edit resets approval. Domain and path define the permitted scope. Retrieval methods are metadata only; the pilot supports manual URL entry exclusively.
publicConfirmation: The source is publicly accessible. This alone does not replace documented source approval.
ownWords: Briefly describe in your own words the problem or recurring effort indicated by the source. Do not include quotations, names, contact details or sensitive personal cases. Check the title and URL too. The server never retrieves the URL.
itemHint: Optional: stable post/issue ID, never a person ID. URL and identity cannot be changed after capture.
minimized: I used my own wording and removed unnecessary personal details from the text, title and URL. No medical or other sensitive individual cases.
loadError: The data could not be loaded. Please try again.
empty: No matching signals yet. First create a source and document its approval.
retentionHint: New and reviewed-but-not-relevant signals expire after 30 days. Discarding removes content immediately; the minimised duplicate block lasts at most 30 days. Relevant signals require review after 180 days. Expired content is hidden. No cron: clean up regularly, up to 250 records at a time.
sourceReviewHint: Approval requires public access, documented policies/terms, a review note and a future review date (at most 180 days). Approval is an accountable decision, not automatic legal clearance. Pausing/withdrawing immediately blocks dependent signals; reactivation does not automatically reapprove them.
noSource: No currently approved, active source for manual URL entry. Please review the source register.
reviewHint: Mark as reviewed first, then optionally approve as relevant. Relevant only means a usable indication, not proof of demand or a market. You may review your own findings. Discarding removes the texts and cannot be undone.
editHint: Saving resets review approval. An existing 30-day retention period is not extended.

results.invalid: Not saved. Check the input, source approval and permitted status transition; reopen the current version if needed.
results.conflict: This version has changed. Please reload and review again.
results.duplicate: This source/URL has already been captured. The existing record was not changed.
results.purged: Expired records cleaned up (at most 250 per run). Repeat if needed.

hypotheses.title: Hypotheses
hypotheses.meaning: A manually formulated working assumption. Reviewed does not mean proven or validated.
hypotheses.editorHint: Use your own minimised wording without personal cases. Every edit requires another review. Explicitly record missing coverage and counter-observations.
hypotheses.loadError: Could not load data. Please try again.
hypotheses.independence: Register sources and domains are not independent voices. Origin groups only identify manually recorded shared originals/crossposts. Independence between groups remains unknown; ungrouped signals are not counted as independent origins.
hypotheses.needsReview: The previous review is no longer effective: evidence or deadlines have changed. Remove unusable associations or explicitly associate the current approved signal revision, then review again.
hypotheses.unavailable: This associated revision is currently unavailable. Its origin and content are not displayed here.
hypotheses.originHint: Use the same short key only for known shared originals or crossposts, e.g. original-1. No person names. Leave empty if unknown. Re-associating replaces revision and group; it does not count the signal twice.
hypotheses.reviewHint: Review wording, context, counter-observations and limitations. At least one currently usable signal is required; all associated revisions must be usable. Self-review is permitted in this pilot. Archiving stops further handoffs.
hypotheses.retention: Draft and archived hypotheses: 30 days. Reviewed hypotheses: review again within 180 days; delete after another 30 days without review. Expired records are hidden. Manual cleanup, up to 250 per run. Minimal import provenance remains for takedown while the private import exists.
hypotheses.handoffGate: Handoff requires a currently reviewed hypothesis, your active CONNECT membership and your active CONNECT profile. Admin rights do not replace these requirements.
hypotheses.handoffHint: This creates a new private workspace owned by you. Deliberately choose a title, starting description and individual signal copies. The hypothesis becomes an assumption. No publication, additional members, opportunities or ventures.
hypotheses.copySummary: Copy this editorial summary as an external perspective
hypotheses.confirm: I reviewed this preview and want to copy exactly these contents into my new private workspace.
hypotheses.importHint: You are the technical author of the handoff, not the external source author. Radar imports remain identifiable. If an approved basis becomes unavailable, untouched imports are hidden and may be specifically redacted; the assumption depends on all associated signals. Your later edits are detached per field. There is no live content synchronisation.
hypotheses.importCount: Copied as starting context into {n} workspaces.
hypotheses.restricted: Approved basis no longer usable; controlled material is hidden.
hypotheses.redactionHint: This overview exposes only Radar import provenance and aggregate counts. It grants no access to private workspaces. Restrictions take effect immediately on read. Confirmed redaction permanently removes only still-controlled Radar texts and links. Later independent edits are preserved.
hypotheses.redactionCount: Currently affected: {texts} controlled texts and {links} controlled source links. Shared assumptions may depend on several signals.
hypotheses.redactionConfirm: Permanently redact these still-controlled Radar imports. Authorization and current state are checked again on confirmation.

fields.title: Title
fields.evidence_limits: Known limitations, dependencies and missing coverage
